name: Adding Chemicals to Water Supply Permits
description:
This dataset contains records of permits issued for adding chemicals to water supplies, with 175 sampled rows and 18 columns. Each row represents a permit and includes a permit number, expiration date, and status (Current or Historical), along with the business name and address of the permit holder. Location fields include street address, city, state, ZIP code, and borough, with many records marked as outside New York City. For permits tied to New York City locations, the data also provides geographic identifiers such as BBL, BIN, census tract, city council district, community district, and NTA code, plus latitude and longitude coordinates.

The data can be used to map where chemical water-treatment permits are held, monitor upcoming or past expiration dates, and compare current versus historical permits. It also supports analysis of the geographic distribution of permitted businesses, identification of concentrations by neighborhood or district, and research or oversight related to public health and environmental regulation of water treatment.
